family_generator: Uniform 4..8 terminal branches, two observed children per branch; alternate allowed depth sets 1..4 and 2..5, depths drawn independently with replacement. All observed pairs retained, including merged biological sibling branches at depth1.
topology_separation: Reject duplicate sorted branch-depth multisets within training and diagnostic; diagnostic additionally excludes every training multiset. Different family seeds alone are insufficient. Record all topologies before meiosis simulation.
inferred_sibling_policy: Connected components of pairs with frozen phase-model sibling probability >=0.95 and IBD2 fraction >=0.10; accept only complete cliques, otherwise split entire component into singletons. No truth groups.
features: Frozen phased pair summaries plus inferred sibling-clique sizes; at 5/10cM graph edges, integrated distinct nonconflicting homolog components represented in both target groups, and in target groups plus each third inferred group. Group-level triple summaries are symmetric mean,minimum,maximum,quartiles and normalized by target pooled sharing. No rooting/generation prior or observed label enters features.
graph_rules: Per chromosome, merge overlapping duplicate intervals on each sample-homolog edge, filter by full edge length, sweep interval boundaries, union active sample-homolog nodes. Components containing both homologs of one sample are marked conflicted and excluded from sharing counts; report conflict mass separately. Each distinct component counts once, including IBD2 components separately. Nodes and groups are unlabeled for summary purposes.
ablation: Otherwise identical forest on only phased pair features, trained on the same new whole-family data. Existing frozen pair forest also reported.
approximation_controls: Exact ancestral edges thresholded at2cM for pair summaries,5/10cM for graph summaries
Fixed deterministic20% edge dropout stress using a separately recorded random seed, applied before feature computation; diagnostic only
exact_screen: Primary exact diagnostic gain >=0.05 over same-data pair-only ablation and macro recall no lower. This screen only allows a detected development experiment; it is not a readiness or confirmation gate.
confirmation_policy: Existing reserved202614... confirmation remains unexecuted unless source/model/calibration frozen and complete coverage,0.80exact,0.70macro,0.50minimum-label,+0.10baseline gain,no cohort regression are reached on new detected development data.
budget: One fixed exact training/diagnostic Slurm job,4CPUs,60minutes; at most four new detected development families if exact screen passes. No parameter search.
limitations: Simulation-based hypothesis extending multiway IBD to distant all-cousin classes; no published validation is claimed
Fixed simple outbred star pedigrees do not represent full Task10 distribution
Graph transitivity may amplify detector errors; dropout stress is only a partial control
